'''Quincy Douby''' is a guard for the [[Rutgers University|Rutgers]] Scarlet Knights.  Known for his incredible three point shooting and all around scoring abilities, he is currently expected to be drafted in the first round of the 2006 NBA Draft.


==2003-04 Season==
Douby made a big impact as a true freshman at Rutgers, highlighted by his great play in Rutgers NIT run, that ended with a loss to Michigan in the Finals.

== 2004-05 Season ==
Douby jumped onto the scenes in his sophomore year averaging a respectable 15.1 points a game (11th in the [[Big East]]) and 3.38 assists a game.  He was named Big East player of the Week along with West Virginia's Tyrone Sally the week of November 29.

== 2005-06 Season ==
In his junior year, Douby skeeted and was named to the All Big-East team.  With his unbelievable shooting and penetrating abilities, he led the Big East in scoring with 25.1 points a game.  After leading Rutgers to a first round victory in the Big East tournament over Seton Hall, Douby dropped 31 over the #2 [[Villanova Wildcats]].  Despite keeping it close in the first half, Villanova ran away with it in the second hald ending Rutgers's hopes of a NCAA tournament birth. On May 15, 2006, Douby officially hired an agent making himself ineligible to return to college.
